questions.q: The slope of a line which cuts off intercepts of equal length on the positive sides of the two axes is —
questions.work: The line is x/a + y/a = 1, i.e. x + y = a, so y = −x + a and the slope is −1.

questions.q: The foot of the perpendicular from (2, 3) to the line y = 3x + 4 is —
The slope of a line which makes 60° with the negative direction of the x-axis is —
questions.work: Angle with the positive x-axis = 180° − 60° = 120°; slope = tan 120° = −√3.

sections.title: Objective type questions of two 1-mark parts.

questions.q: (a) The slope of the line y + 3 = 0 is ______. (b) The slope of the line through (2, 5) and (4, 9) is ______.
questions.answer:
(a) y = −3 is parallel to the x-axis ⇒ slope 0.
(b) (9 − 5)/(4 − 2) = 2.

questions.q: Fill in the blanks: (a) The line through (1, −2) cutting equal intercepts on the axes is ______. (b) Two lines are perpendicular if m₁m₂ = ______.
questions.answer:
(a) x + y = a passes through (1, −2) ⇒ a = −1 ⇒ x + y + 1 = 0.
(b) −1

sections.title: Objective type questions of four 1-mark parts.

questions.q: For the line 3x − 4y + 12 = 0 find: (a) its slope; (b) its x-intercept; (c) its y-intercept; (d) its distance from the origin.
Find the value of k for which the line (k − 3)x − (4 − k²)y + k² − 7k + 6 = 0 is parallel to the x-axis.
questions.answer:
Parallel to the x-axis means the coefficient of x is zero: k − 3 = 0 ⇒ k = 3.
(Check: the y-coefficient −(4 − 9) = 5 ≠ 0, so it is a genuine line.)

questions.q: Find the equation of the line through the intersection of x + y = 5 and 2x − y − 7 = 0, parallel to the x-axis.
questions.answer: Adding: 3x = 12 ⇒ x = 4, then y = 1. A line parallel to the x-axis through (4, 1) is y = 1.
